title: SON OF THE FATHER

cover.scene: Jesus (calm, rim-lit) and Barabbas (in chains) side by side before the crowd, 'BARABBAS = ???' glowing above

voice.note: same voice as Q.01 and Q.02

name_fact: In Aramaic, 'bar' means 'son' and 'abba' means 'father', so 'Barabbas' means 'son of the father'.

kjv.John 18:39: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover…
kjv.Matthew 27:2: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
kjv.Matthew 27:17: …Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
kjv.Mark 15:7: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
kjv.Mark 15:11: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
kjv.Matthew 27:21: …Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
kjv.Matthew 27:26: Then released he Barabbas unto them…
kjv.1 Peter 3:18: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God…

rules: family-safe: no blood, no wounds, no whipping, no crucifixion close-ups; Jesus carrying the cross is seen from far away only; riots shown as shadows and running, no violence
God the Father is never shown as a person, only as light; Jesus is a simple figure, no halo, no realistic face
never blame any group of people for Jesus' death; keep it personal: we all needed Him to take our place
kind and non-denominational; never mock anyone

beats.text: This is *Jesus*. In a moment, a crowd will choose a *murderer* over Him.
beats.tts: This is Jesus. | In a moment, a crowd will choose a murderer over Him.
beats.camera: frame 1: low-angle close hero shot of Jesus, calm and still on the stone pavement at dawn, sun rising behind Him (gold rim light), wind in robe and hair, glowing dust; a huge roaring crowd out of focus behind with fists raised; FAST orbit that speed-ramps into slow motion and ends on His calm face as He lifts His eyes
sfx: layered crowd roar with chant-like pulses (no words)
deep hit on the hook title
roar drops into an underwater slow-motion feel: wind, one deep held note, a heartbeat

beats.text: And that murderer's name… will *shock* you.
beats.tts: And that murderer's name… will shock you.
beats.camera: whip pan reveals a second man beside Jesus in heavy iron chains: Barabbas glares at the crowd; chains swing

namecard.note: appears under the captions with a soft glow and a tiny lock; stays until line 9

beats.text: Every Passover, the governor set one prisoner *free*.
beats.tts: Every Passover, the governor set one prisoner free.
beats.camera: big crane-up from the courtyard to a wide view of Jerusalem at Passover: crowds in the streets, banners, smoke rising from the temple in the haze
low angle on Pilate on the raised stone judgment seat, uneasy; soldiers lead the two men forward side by side: Jesus in warm light (wrists bound with a simple rope), Barabbas in hard shadow

beats.text: Jesus… who healed the sick and raised the *dead*.
beats.tts: Jesus… who healed the sick and raised the dead.
beats.camera: over Jesus' shoulder, glowing 'memory' vignettes appear and fade like light paintings (~0.7 s each): a blind man's eyes opening, a child lifted up, Lazarus walking out of a tomb in white cloth

beats.text: And Barabbas. A rebel who had "committed *murder* in the insurrection."
beats.tts: And Barabbas. | A rebel who had committed murder in the insurrection.
beats.camera: hard cut to a quick shadowy night flashback: a street riot with torches, an overturned cart, people running as shadows (no violence, no blood)

beats.text: Pilate asked: "Whether of the twain will ye that I *release* unto you?"
beats.tts: Pilate asked: Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you?
beats.camera: Pilate stands and raises one hand toward each man; the crowd goes quiet; the chief priests move through the crowd whispering into ears

card.text: …Whether of the twain will ye that I *release* unto you?

beats.camera: the crowd explodes, fists in the air, dust, camera shake; the word BARABBAS slams onto the screen in huge shaking letters; Jesus stays perfectly still in the middle of it all

beats.text: But notice his name. In Aramaic, "Bar" means *son*. "Abba" means *father*.
beats.tts: But notice his name. | In Aramaic, Bar… means son. | Abba… means father.
beats.camera: freeze frame, the world drains to dark with a soft spotlight; the locked name card flies to the centre and grows; the lock breaks; the letters split into BAR and ABBA with tags SON and FATHER

beats.tts: Barabbas means son of the father.
beats.camera: BAR | ABBA re-form into SON OF THE FATHER in glowing gold; big hit

beats.text: So that day, a guilty son of the father walked *free*…
beats.tts: So that day, a guilty son of the father walked free…
beats.camera: slow motion: a guard unlocks Barabbas's shackles and they fall to the stone with a heavy clank; he walks toward the city gate into warm light

beats.text: …and the true Son of the *Father* died in his place.
beats.tts: and the true Son of the Father died in his place.
beats.camera: in the same shot Jesus is led the other way with His bound hands, toward the hill outside the wall under a darkening sky (split composition, warm vs grey)

beats.tts: Then released he Barabbas unto them.

beats.text: Barabbas didn't *earn* it. He didn't even *ask* for it.
beats.tts: Barabbas didn't earn it. | He didn't even ask for it.
beats.camera: at the city gate Barabbas stops and turns around; far away through the crowd he sees Jesus carrying the wooden cross beam up the hill (from far away only)

beats.text: He walked out… because Jesus walked *in*.
beats.tts: He walked out… because Jesus walked in.
beats.camera: his hard face slowly softens; rack focus from Barabbas to the distant hill

beats.text: "For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the *just* for the *unjust*, that he might bring us to God."
beats.tts: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the Just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God.
beats.camera: warm light breaking through the clouds above the hill (God shown only as light)

card.text: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the *just* for the *unjust*, that he might bring us to God…

beats.text: And here's the truth: *you* are Barabbas. So am I.
beats.tts: And here's the truth: you are Barabbas. | So am I.
beats.camera: push-in on Barabbas's face, then a match cut on the same pose and silhouette to a modern person (hoodie, jeans) on a modern street at night in the same art style; they look up as warm light falls on them

beats.text: If you were Barabbas, what would you say to Jesus? *One line*.
beats.tts: If you were Barabbas, what would you say to Jesus? | One line.
beats.camera: dark warm background; the name card glows SON OF THE FATHER; a comment box types 'Thank You for taking my place 🙏' with floating hearts
